t: Douglas Rushkoff Deconstructs the Digital Economy

q.x: Its amazing to watch how some of the smartest people on the planet can get stuck on tracks they can't get of. Highly recommend Douglas Rushkoff on this - [link]

desc:
Recorded March 30, 2016 at 92nd Street Y. 

Digital technology was supposed to usher in a new age of endless prosperity, but so far it has been used to put industrial capitalism on steroids, with Internet startups selling for billions, but destroying more jobs than they create, extracting more cash from circulation than they put in, and disrupting entire marketplaces and neighborhoods in the proce
